scientific.integrity: The closest crosspolytope moment theorem and two highly relevant full-text width-distribution papers were materially inspected. Exact-object, equivalent maximum-coordinate, caliper/Feret, and formula searches were performed. The proof is analytic; numerical quadrature in the bundled checker is only an independent consistency test.
limitations: The exact CDF is proved only for the three-dimensional regular crosspolytope with unit edge length, up to trivial scaling.
The older all-moment formula already characterizes this compactly supported law implicitly; the present claim is the explicit closed evaluation.
No assertion is made about random chord length or a dimension-free crosspolytope CDF.

title: Exact width distribution of the unit-edge regular octahedron
